prompt: Some people think it is better to educate boys and girls in separate schools. Others, however, believe that boys and girls benefit more from attending mixed schools. Discuss bot these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
In modern life, some people agree with the concept of mixed schools. Others, however, think it is better to educate both boys and girls in separate schools. In my opinion, students' skills can be developed better in separate schools because both genders will be able to learn their own distinctions , and teachers can treat each gender separately in an appropriate way.

On the one hand, educating males and females in mixed schools can provide a collaborative environment that includes girls and boys in the same field. As a result, this helps each of them to recognise the opposite sex. For example, mixed classes include both sexes with cooperative learning method can help students of both genders to recognise each other due to the direct interaction and learning approach. Moreover, the concept of dual-gender educational institution can lead both males and females to communicate and interacte between each other in the future, such as in the workplace  or public places.

On the other hand, separating boys and girls in a private school allows them to develop their distinct abilities. This is because the teachers can guide and teach each gender separately, so they can dedicate  full concentration to a certain gender in order to develop their specific skills. For instance, males are known for their physical ability, so administrators can teach boys how to play football or tennis, the same can be observed in females' artistic sense of drawing.

In conclusion, mixed educational institutions have the ability to develop social skills in males and females. However, skills can be developed better in  single-sex schools because there is a full focus environment with specialised teachers.
